title: Canter
summary: CANTER, verb intransitive To move as a horse in a moderate gallop, raising the two fore feet nearly at the same time, with a leap or spring. CANTER, verb transitive To ride upon a canter CANTER, noun

inlines.v: CANTER, verb intransitive To move as a horse in a moderate gallop, raising the two fore feet nearly at the same time, with a leap or spring. CANTER, verb transitive To ride upon a canter CANTER, noun 1. A moderate gallop. 2. One who cants or whines. CANTERBURY BELL, noun A species of campanula. [See Bell-Flower.] CANTERBURY TALE, noun A fabulous story; so called from the tales of Chaucer.
